feature: NextE-derived native Reader zoom gesture boundary
precondition: An existing complete app-private download was retained; no account session, gallery title, page URL, or image content was recorded.
steps: Installed the current debug-signed HAP with replace semantics.
Opened Downloads, used the complete task Read action, and confirmed the Reader counter was 1 / 55.
Injected a two-tap sequence at the Reader surface, then a vertical swipe; the counter remained 1 / 55.
Injected a second two-tap sequence to reset zoom, then the same vertical swipe; the counter advanced to 2 / 55.
result: Passed: the Reader-surface double-tap command reaches the visible page and gates vertical scrolling only while zoomed.
limits: This UiTest protocol exercises double-tap and the List gate. Pinch uses the official ArkUI two-finger gesture API and is covered by compile and source contract checks; this record does not claim multi-touch injection evidence.
